summary: Macerich Co filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a registered public offering of 22,080,000 shares of common stock, plus the full exercise of a 30-day underwriter option for an additional 2,880,000 shares, at $21.00 per share. Net proceeds will be contributed to its operating partnership to repay revolving credit facility borrowings used for the Annapolis Mall acquisition. The underwriters are led by Goldman Sachs. This is a routine equity capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special-situation event.
